_what: The director's rulings on AIMS-IA generated items. `rounds` records what was READ; `rejections` records every item refused, by item_id, with its reason and ruling.

rounds.note: AIMS-IA's FIRST round, and the cleanest first round of any certification: 88 survivors of 136 generated at $0.2227 each, and only 2 of 88 rejected on quality (2%). All 3 judge flags upheld; 1 missed (ec6ba56a/61fabc8a), a CROSS-ANCHOR pair the neighbour arm could not see because the bank held no live items to draw neighbours from.

ZERO QUALITY REJECTS across all three R2 artifacts: no item was refused for being wrong. Every loss is a REPEAT -- 17 of 89 = 19%, in line with ISMS-IA's 17%. Judge: 18 flagged, 17 upheld, 1 OVERRULED (da8a188d), 1 missed (ea523ed8/7266c77d, cross-anchor with few shared key terms).

overruled_judge_flags.why: ACCEPTED over the judge's flag: its neighbour ab402c75 keys on 42001 8.2, which covers RISK assessment results, while this keys on 8.4 and the results of every IMPACT assessment. The documented-information duty is separate per clause, so a candidate can know one and miss the other.
